text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): captureGovernedProviderProjection samples tracked, untracked and ignored worktree manifests under MAX_GOVERNED_PROJECTION_ENTRIES = 100000. A planning worktree provisioned with the consumer node_modules (about 132000 ignored files) exhausts the budget, so the PlanReview invocation fails with GOVERNED_PROJECTION_FAILED. This contradicts the OpenSpec requirement that node_modules exist in the same worktree. Workaround that passed: copy only the OpenSpec dependency closure (84 pnpm entries, about 5100 files). The engine should exclude ignored dependency trees from the projection budget or provision a minimal closure itself.
